added: A calendar import now notices when an event you imported has changed or been canceled. A changed title, date or location is offered in the review, ticked if you haven't touched the draft and unticked if you have, and nothing changes until you choose Import. A canceled event, or one no longer in your calendar, is never deleted or edited: its program is labeled Canceled in your calendar or No longer in your calendar in the Programs list and on its summary, and you can clear the label there. Undo puts back everything an import changed.
data_migrations: The same schema v42 step also adds three hidden program columns the calendar import uses to see what changed. Nothing in your library changes.
